title: gnetum indicum
intro: Gnetum indicum, commonly known as the Asiatic tree fern or adhatoda, is a plant species belonging to the family Gnetaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gnetum indicum include its use as an antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to manage various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Gnetum indicum include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
